data.content_ref: inline:Kind: Contradiction. The isolated problem's demand for a non-inductive justification contradicts SRC_001's reliance on 'verisimilitude' as a metric, because verisimilitude implicitly assumes a uniformity of nature (that closer-to-truth theories survive) which is itself an inductive assumption. REFUTED IF: Verisimilitude can be rigorously defined and measured using purely logical content analysis without any assumption about the future behavior of nature or the distribution of truth.
